programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep02
programme.desc: Launch into spring's snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep03
programme.desc: Weave through Queensland's coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep04
programme.desc: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowner's pets.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep05
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep06
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv's hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep01
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Ep02
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep01
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep02
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who's swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep03

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal Ep04

programme.desc: Shiori is a university student and she suffers from an extreme fear of death. Along with her schoolmates Keita and Maho, they scout a location for Keita's graduation film project. The location is an abandoned apartment complex that is infamous for paranormal sightings. The students meet the mysterious residents of the abandoned apartment complex. The residents believe that they are living with ghosts in the apartment. Keita and Maho become frightened and want to leave right away, but Shiori is sceptical and believes the supernatural phenomena are fake. She convinces her friends that they should investigate the claims.

programme.title: Buyut
programme.desc: Based on an urban legend amongst the Bangka Belitung community, Buyut is a mythological creature or water ghoul that lives in the bodies of water. The story begins when a newlywed couple Bima and Kanaya move into a home bought from an auction after its previous owners passed away. After a while, Kanaya begins to notice odd happenings occuring in their new home.

programme.title: Kerat 14
programme.desc: Haziq dan Nuzara merupakan pasangan kekasih dan Haziq amat menyayangi Nurzara, namun Haziq terlibat dengan aktiviti sosial dan tidak disenangi oleh Nuzara. Dalam masa yang sama Aril muncul dan mula tertarik dengan kecantikan Nuzara ketika Nuzara dan Haziq berada di salah sebuah kelab di Kuala Lumpur. Sebuah tragedi ngeri yang tidak disengajakan telah berlaku dalam kisah cinta Haziq dan Nuzara dan penyiasatan dilakukan oleh ASP Razman.

programme.title: Haunted Tales
programme.desc: In 'Haunted Car', a young businessman, Pete, takes a taxi back home from the airport. The driver makes a detour and starts to reveal shocking secrets hidden deep in Pete's tormented past. The second story is 'Reborn', about Tiwa, a girl with the power to communicate with the dead. When she tries to help the owner of a huanted hotel to set captive spirits free, she finds out the truth about a gruesome murder in one of the rooms. Finally in 'The Book of Truth', Jess, a horror writer, receives a mysterious e-mail about the strange curse of ancient scripts engraved on palm leaves. Everything written on the leaves will become true.

programme.title: The Disapearance of Irdina Adhwa
programme.desc: A year after Irdina disappears, a few of her friends take a trip to an isolated part of Kundasang. Horror starts at midnight when Sofie finds another friend with his throat slit open. Sofie and the rest try to figure out how to survive until dawn, but one by one, they fall victim to a masked assailant. But one of them gets a glimpse of the man behind the mask, who forces the victim to look at a photograph of Irdina.

programme.title: Iblis Dalam Darah
programme.desc: Haruni is possessed by a demon who often compels her to hurt herself. Distraught, her younger sister, Hanum, unloads her woes to her eye doctor, Ahmad, who is also a religious person. Curious, he offers to attend Haruni's exorcism. But during the midst of the session, he realises that the demon within Haruni is related to a recent suicide case.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: Don't Talk To Strangers
programme.desc: This psychological thriller depicts the disturbing tale of the emotionally unstable Emmy, who is led to Ireland in search of answers about her family's curse. There, she meets a seemingly helpful stranger who guides her through her investigation on the mysterious origin of the curse.

programme.title: Kampungku Ada Hantu
programme.desc: Nayan pulang ke kampung dan bertemu dengan Maria, seorang wanita misteri dan pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku semenjak itu. Lakonan Along Cham & Julia Ziegler.

programme.title: Lembur
programme.desc: Tommy is a designer. He has been toiling away at a website design but his colleague accuses him of plagiarism. To Tommy's dismay, even his boss is unimpressed and hits the roof, bellowing at Tommy to rework the entire design and stay up all night if he must. Without a choice, Tommy hunkers down to pull an all-nighter in the office. Late at night with no one else around, terror strikes. Is he alone in the office, or not?

programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: An aspiring flight attendant named Soo-hyeon agrees to a one-week part time job at a convenience store that pays suspiciously too well. What she initially thought would be easy money is nothing like she ever imagined as the strange customers and the mysterious store owner creates an unpredictable horror.

programme.title: Midnight Horror

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

programme.title: The Eyes

She also has to undergo eye transplant surgery to regain her vision. But right after the surgery, Trang starts seeing a lady ghost with bloodshot eyes following her around. She decides to investigate the spooky encounters and discovers unimaginable secrets that her very own husband has been trying to hide from her.
